messages.author: f769d7d2cfcf4edc
messages.subject: Re: Using RStan to develop Latent class Multinomial Logit Model
parts:
See the last post on this thread:

https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups#!category-topic/stan-users/general/SPlQPDH6f6U

That script takes as data a vector (x) which you assume has K latent classes of gaussian-distributed data.
It uses soft clustering, so each individual has some probability, pi, of belonging to each cluster.
Pi is estimated from softmax regression (multinomial logistic) from intercepts, beta0, and predictors, beta.
"predictors" is a matrix WITHOUT a column for the intercept (the intercept is assumed by beta0).

It's not pretty code, but it works.
